clue.text: A dotty way to decorate!

parts.note: dotty seems to mean crazy, but read literally it is decoration done entirely in dots

explanation.surface: An eccentric approach to doing up a room.
explanation.definitionFit: The technique of applying paint or ink in many small dots is a decorative method built from dots.

clue.text: Picture furniture embellished with gold

indicators.note: the furniture is decorated with, so followed by, the gold

parts.note: a table is an item of furniture
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A painting shows furniture decorated with gilt.
explanation.definitionFit: A tableau is a striking scene or picture, as in a staged tableau vivant.

clue.text: A morsel of food taken before church

indicators.note: the food is placed in front of the church

parts.note: a pie is a kind of food
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone eats a little something on the way to church.
explanation.definitionFit: A morsel is a small bit, and a piece is a portion or bit of something.

clue.text: Bolster arranged on the bed at sea

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of the word are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A long pillow is laid out on a bunk aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bolster' and 'bed' suggest bedding, but the definition describes a creature living on the seabed.
explanation.definitionFit: This crustacean lives on the sea floor, so it is literally found on the bed at sea.

clue.text: Pop in a pair the Spanish wear

indicators.note: the dad goes inside the couple of letters for a pair

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father, pa
el is the Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Dad squeezes into a couple of Spanish garments.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing worn is wear, as in menswear, a synonym for garments.

clue.text: Shoot at duck to be served at dinner, perhaps

definitions.text: to be served at dinner, perhaps

parts.note: to pot is to shoot game
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, the letter O

explanation.surface: A hunter fires at a duck destined for the dinner table.
explanation.definitionFit: A root vegetable is typically something served at dinner, with perhaps marking this as one example.

clue.text: They'll be there returning thanks over offers made

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over, above, the second
returning means the word for thanks is read backwards

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks
tenders are formal offers

explanation.surface: People who will turn up are thanked after bids are submitted.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who attend an event are the people who will be there.

clue.text: Key given to a demanding Oriental

parts.note: E is a musical key
stern means strict or demanding

explanation.surface: A tough Asian character is handed a key.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriental and this word both describe things of the East, used here as an adjective.

clue.text: Strict control of budget meeting may be held

indicators.note: the budget word holds the rearranged meeting inside it

parts.note: a ration is a fixed allowance or budget

indicators.note: may be signals that the letters of meeting are only a possible version and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A budget meeting enforces tight discipline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' rearranges MEETING into EGIMENT, and 'held' puts that inside RATION, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Regimentation means imposing strict order and discipline, as in an army regiment.

clue.text: A president without money, but with some power

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the president goes around the money

parts.note: Abe Lincoln was a US president
L stands for pound, the British currency

explanation.surface: A head of state who is broke still keeps some influence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but here means outside: ABE goes around L.
explanation.definitionFit: Being capable means having the power or skill to do something.

clue.text: Blow the checkout!

parts.note: seems like a curse on a shop till, but read as an instruction for a roadside police test where a driver blows into a device

explanation.surface: An exasperated shopper curses the supermarket till.
explanation.walkthrough: A breathalyser check is done by blowing into a device, so 'blow' and 'check out' describe it.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadside breathalyser check requires the driver to blow into a tube to measure alcohol.

clue.text: Speculate about the judge being destitute

indicators.note: about means the speculating word goes around the judge

parts.note: to bet is to speculate or gamble
a ref, referee, judges a game

explanation.surface: A gambler bets on the referee and ends up broke.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean deprived or left without, here of means.

clue.text: Planned at home and taken care of

parts.note: in means at home
tended means looked after

explanation.surface: Something deliberately arranged and looked after at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intended was planned or meant on purpose.

clue.text: Have a drink with the caretaker, a fan

parts.note: to sup is to drink
a porter looks after a building, a caretaker

explanation.surface: Sharing a drink with the janitor, who is an admirer.
explanation.definitionFit: A fan backs a team or performer, as a follower or backer does.

clue.text: Extensive block accommodating almost everyone

indicators.note: the block word accommodates, holds, the shortened everyone

parts.note: to prevent is to block

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: A large apartment block houses nearly all residents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts ALL to AL, which goes inside PREVENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something widespread or common is extensive in its reach.

clue.text: A foreign writer who was never translated

indicators.note: translated means the word is turned into a different form, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: An overseas author whose work never appeared in English.
explanation.walkthrough: Jules Verne, the French novelist of Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea, is the writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Jules Verne was a French science-fiction novelist, so a writer from abroad.

clue.text: Drop outside right for a bit

indicators.note: the dropping word goes outside the right

parts.note: to shed is to drop or cast off

explanation.surface: Dropping the outside-right footballer for a while.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside right' looks like a football position, but 'outside' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny scrap or fragment is a bit, as in not a shred of evidence.

clue.text: Try to accept the growth of moorland

indicators.note: the trying word takes in the definite article

parts.note: to hear a case is to try it in court

explanation.surface: Trying to take in the plants of the moors.
explanation.definitionFit: This low shrub with purple flowers grows widely on moors.

clue.text: Dwelling on street with tricky ingress

indicators.note: tricky suggests the letters of the word are scrambled

explanation.surface: Thinking about a road with an awkward entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell on something is to emphasise it repeatedly.

clue.text: Going on totally without motive

parts.note: an end is an aim or motive
less means without, as in a pie less a slice

explanation.surface: Proceeding completely without any reason.
explanation.definitionFit: Something going on forever, totally without stopping, never ceases.

clue.text: A girl getting in late — a mistake

indicators.note: a mistake suggests the letters are jumbled out of order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl arriving late makes an error.
explanation.definitionFit: A common girl's first name.

clue.text: Fruit for both mother and child

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal
a son is a child

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit shared between parent and offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dark purple plum is a fruit.

clue.text: There's a big fall in optical deterioration

definitions.meaning: a clouding of the eye lens that worsens sight

explanation.surface: A large drop in eyesight quality.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a great waterfall and an eye condition clouding the lens.

clue.text: Top Venetian's responsibility to see animal fed

parts.note: a dog is an animal
ate means fed, consumed food

explanation.surface: A Venetian leader must ensure the pet is fed.
explanation.walkthrough: The Doge was the elected head of Venice; his office or term is the dogate.
explanation.definitionFit: The office of the Doge, Venice's chief magistrate, is the Doge's duty and responsibility.

clue.text: Port found in luggage — no action taken

indicators.note: found in signals the answer sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A bag left unclaimed at the harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Genoa is a major Italian seaport.

clue.text: The cut includes military personnel — quite a number

indicators.note: the phrase the cut takes the soldiers inside it

parts.note: taken as written
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to score is to cut a mark

explanation.surface: Army staff are among those cut, a sizable figure.
explanation.walkthrough: RE goes in after the TH of THE SCORE.
explanation.definitionFit: Sixty is a fairly large number.

clue.text: Invalid Greek character attended by inexperienced persons

parts.note: nu is a letter of the Greek alphabet
L is a learner, so two learners are LL

explanation.surface: A Greek character with novices beside him is void.
explanation.definitionFit: Null and void means without legal force.

clue.text: Note counting is so tiresome!

parts.note: G is a musical note
rating is assessing, counting value

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry about tallying notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something irritating is tiresome or annoying.

clue.text: Possibly sees about covering leaks

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go about the covering
possibly signals another arrangement of the letters

parts.note: a cap is a covering

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone spots a cap over drips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' rearranges SEES to ESES, which goes around CAP.
explanation.definitionFit: Escapes of gas or fluid are leaks.
